'''H. Starfinder''' was a member of the [[Liana Liberators]]. The name ''H. Starfinder'' was an alias used as part of the Liberators' attempt to pose as members of the [[Alderaanian Biological Research Institute]] when they came to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It is unknown what the real name of this person was.
